record.description: Struthiomimus was an ornithomimid ('ostrich dinosaur') of Late Cretaceous western North America — a long-legged, bipedal, toothless-beaked runner. Its abundance and beak suggest it was an opportunistic omnivore.

notableFacts.text: Long-legged and ostrich-like, built for running.
Its toothless beak suggests an opportunistic, largely plant-based omnivorous diet.
